plugins.name: desktop-diagram-hint
plugins.description: In Claude desktop's Code tab, tells Claude to draw diagrams with the built-in visualize widget instead of mermaid blocks.

plugins.name: vscode-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notifications on the computer you're sitting at when Claude finishes or needs you, even from WSL, dev containers or Remote-SSH. Pairs with two small VS Code extensions.

plugins.name: vscode-images
plugins.description: A ShowImage tool that shows the pictures Claude wants you to see in a floating VS Code window, leaving the keyboard in the terminal. Pairs with a small VS Code extension.
